formula: For cap256 use exact pilot served diagnostic_wall_s_including_prefill. For cap512 use matched observed cap512 diagnostic_wall_s_including_prefill. For cap1024 preserve matched cap512 prefill/host overhead (diagnostic wall minus decode wall), and project decode as measured decode_wall_s * (1023/511). Sum 108 cases; add observed served cap-extension model-load diagnostic wall and fixed 180-second first-preparation allowance. Uncertainty range applies 0.7x–1.5x to case generation sum only; load and prep fixed.
interpretation: Diagnostic serial runtime planning range, not serving performance, device time, a score projection, or a measured HiFi2 result.
